title: Pip and the Pot
retell: Can you tell me where Pip hid, and how Mom found Pip?

pages.text: Pip can nap on a mat.
Pip can nap in a pan.
Mom got a pot. It is on a mat.
Mom did not spot Pip in the pot.
Tap, tap, tap. Mom got a pin.
Mom tips the pot. It is Pip!
Pip is not a pot cat. Go to the mat, Pip!

questions.q: What do you think Pip will do next?
